description: A radial action menu for Uno Platform built to the Control Gallery prototype: an accent trigger that opens up to five actions on a 90° arc, 22.5° apart, with a 30 ms stagger out and the reverse on close, a dotted guide and a scrim. Keys 1 to 5 pick, the arrows move, Esc closes; a finger can slide from the trigger to an item, whose name shows in a readout, and release to pick. Discs are 52 px with label pills and key badges on desktop, 56 px with badges only on a phone; the arc mirrors at the left edge and unavailable actions dim. Archivo is bundled; warm greys with a rust accent, Light and Dark with an in-app switch. The demo is the prototype's Contacts panel.

showcase.summary: A radial quick-action menu: five actions on a quarter arc, keyboard keys, touch slide-to-pick, labels or badges.
goals: A templated control that places its trigger 24 px from a corner and lays up to five items on a 90° arc, 22.5° apart
Open and close storyboards from the design: 30 ms stagger and 320 ms settle out, 20 ms and 200 ms back, plus scrim, guide and plus rotation
Keyboard: Space opens and focuses the first item, 1-5 pick, arrows move, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger
Touch: press the trigger, slide to an item (HighlightedIndex, readout), release to pick
State API: IsOpen, IsHintVisible, HighlightedIndex, ShowLabels, Position (mirrors on the left), per-item IsEnabled, each with visual states
Bundled static Archivo instances mapped to Material's DefaultFontFamily through a weight manifest
